chunks: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us, he said: Hammad ibn Yazid narrated to us, from Ayyub, from Ataa, from Ibn Abbas, who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: The love for Ali ibn Abi Talib consumes the evil deeds in the same way as fire consumes wood.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of loving Imam Ali according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in Fadail al-Shia, this hadith highlights the theological significance of Walayah (divine guardianship) as a means of expiation, where love for Imam Ali (as) acts as a purifying force. The metaphor of fire consuming wood underscores the completeness of this spiritual cleansing, reflecting the Shia belief that attachment to the Ahl al-Bayt is integral to salvation and the removal of minor sins.

en.badr-shahin: Abdullah bin Mohammed bin Abdul-Wahab narrated to us from Hemmad bin Yazid from Ayyoub from Attaa from Ibn Abbas that the Prophet (s) said:
The love for Ali bin Abi Talib consumes the evil deeds in the same way as fire consumes wood.
